description: Add one item to an owned Library List. Generate one new itemId UUID for the item and reuse it on retries, so a retried call never adds a duplicate. Use the listId and expectedVersion from the latest library_list_get. On library_version_mismatch, read the list again and reconsider the change; never retry blindly. Library Lists only, not trip checklists.

expectedVersion.description: Opaque version from the latest library_list_get or Library List tool result.

itemId.description: New caller-generated UUID for the item; reuse the same value when retrying.

listId.description: Library List ID from library_lists_search or library_list_get.

name: library_list_item_add
title: Add Library List Item
